summary: Surveyed all 105 listed .lean files (sizes 233 to 82585 bytes) in reservoir-sources/kim-em__hex-dev and grepped each for Lean declaration keywords. 98 files hold ordinary theorems, defs, structures, and instances on determinants, number-field towers, dense polynomials, real-closed-field coefficients, real closure, sign determination, and Sturm soundness. Seven files matched zero keywords in a first grep; reading them showed that two (FieldRuntime.lean, Tactic.lean) hold meta defs and opaques, and four (Core.lean, ArithmeticCore.lean, FactorGeneric.lean, NormCore.lean) plus RealCoefficients.lean are module aggregators with import lines, 'public section', and module docstrings. Under FILTER-007 these aggregators stay primary-eligible because this review cannot verify the auxiliary delivery path; they are ranked via the navigation-import-only role, not excluded. Default disposition: retain all files.
